text:
meera: FYI customer ACME reporting p95/p99 jump in us-east-1 starting ~10:05 UTC, >3s p99. got a support ticket w/ traces.
alan: grabbing logs, looks like dedicated pool dpool-42 is hitting capacity, attach queue climbing.
jeff: any error codes from attach? I see a bunch of 502s from attach-proxy and a flurry of container image pull failures.
lina: deploy-bot says we rotated the registry key at 09:58 for security. could be related.
meera: support-ops just posted a repro: customer test traffic + billing window ramp at 10:00 -> p99 jumps.
support-ops: repro steps: `wrk -t4 -c200 https://api.redwood.xyz/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"` shows p99 4.2s when hitting dedicated customer route.
alan: checking autoscaler metrics: scale-up launched, but handshake timeouts when attaching new GPUs -> warmup not completing. attach_retry_count spiked.
jeff: stack from attach-proxy: `Error: image pull failed: unauthorized: authentication required` repeated across attempts.
lina: so registry rotation caused image pulls to fail -> new GPUs couldn't pull runtime -> attach effectively stalled -> pool saturated -> queue builds -> p99 spikes. nasty chain.
meera: immediate mitigations? Can we fallback those requests to hosted pool for affected customers?
jeff: yep we have a fallback policy. I can flip route to hosted for ACME while we restore registry creds. will add rate-limit to avoid cost shock.
alan: also increasing attach concurrency and extending attach timeout won't help if image pulls are 401. need to revert registry key or update node-autoscaler secret.
lina: pushed new secret to cluster and kicked a rolling restart for node-autoscaler, started re-attaches at 10:28. seeing successful pulls now.
oncall-bot: incident note: autoscale-attach-failure due to registry key rotation. Severity: P2. Link: https://incidents/redwood/INC-2026-142
support-ops: informed ACME that we're routing them to hosted fallback and working on dedicated recovery. they want ETA.
meera: ETA ~15m to recover capacity, but we'll keep hosted fallback until stable. Jeff please add a customer-safe rollback if attach fails for >2m in future.
jeff: will add a short-circuit: if attach backoff >120s, route to hosted and notify SRE + SE.
alan: postmortem action items: (1) registry rotation playbook — coordinate deploy window for autoscaler, (2) prewarm images on standby nodes before key rotation, (3) attach timeout/degeneration policy tweak, (4) add synthetic canary after key rotate.
lina: monitoring TODOs: add alert when image-pull-auth-fail rate >5/min on autoscaler namespace, and surface attach queue length on customer dashboards.
meera: great. ACME p99 back to normal after routing and re-attaches at 10:44. leaving thread open for follow-ups.
jeff: pushed hotfix for fallback short-circuit and alerting, will open PR and schedule postmortem doc.
support-ops: closing customer ticket, leaving note to escalate if any regressions in next 24h. :thumbsup:
meera: thanks all — add any more notes here and I'll include in summary for oncall rotation.
